apps.name: VAT24
apps.description: Live VATSIM-radar met vluchten, ATC, vliegvelden, routes en vliegtuigfoto's.
apps.changelog:
VAT24 v1.0.26

- Replaced the flight-detail “live position / flown route” card with a FR24-inspired airport time board.
- The board shows SCHEDULED departure and arrival, ACTUAL departure when VAT24 observed the takeoff in the current app session, and a live ESTIMATED arrival.
- Departure and arrival clocks are formatted independently in each airport’s local IANA time zone, including daylight-saving time and UTC offset labels.
- Airport time zones are resolved from airport coordinates through the existing Open-Meteo data source and cached for 30 days; device local time is used only as a temporary/offline fallback.
- Scheduled arrival is derived from the filed VATSIM departure time plus filed enroute time. The estimated arrival remains a VATSIM-position/groundspeed direct-distance estimate.
- Removing the route-preview card moves the aircraft photo higher on the details page while leaving the live radar route itself unchanged.

- Airport board rows are cleaner: arrivals show only the origin airport name and departures only the destination airport name; Van, Naar and duplicate ICAO codes were removed.
- Airport-board EST and filed OUT times are now shown in the device's local time zone instead of Zulu/UTC.
- Girona-Costa Brava (LEGE/GRO) now uses a verified Wikimedia Commons airport photo instead of an unrelated search result.
- Airport photo matching is stricter: ICAO/IATA matches must be real tokens, airport-specific queries are more precise, obvious non-airport subjects are penalized, and the metadata cache was versioned so stale wrong photos are refreshed.
- Live traffic remains VATSIM-only; the existing airport board estimate logic, ATIS/runway detection, map navigation and flight details are otherwise unchanged.

- Airport arrivals/departures now use a more FR24-like board row: arrivals prominently show the origin airport, departures the destination airport.
- Added live EST arrival-time estimates based only on the current VATSIM position and groundspeed; ground departures fall back to the filed VATSIM OUT/EOBT when useful.
- Related airport names are fetched through the existing airport directory cache instead of introducing a second metadata source.
- Runway-in-use detection now reads both VATSIM ATIS stations and controller ATIS text and distinguishes arrival/departure runways where the text allows it.
- When no VATSIM ATIS is available, VAT24 explicitly reports runway-in-use as unknown instead of inventing an external fallback.
- Native radar pinch, double-tap and +/- zoom steps are damped further for smoother local map navigation.
- Existing VATSIM traffic, ATIS, METAR, airport photos, map markers, follow mode and flight details remain intact.

apps.name: Esmarty
apps.description: Material You app voor het vinden en vergelijken van lokale prepaid-eSIMs.
apps.changelog:
Esmarty 0.6.0

  UI redesign
- Simplified the main navigation to Discover, Trips and Wallet.
- Favorites are now integrated into Discover.
- Comparing eSIMs is now contextual instead of using a permanent tab.
- Added more compact and easier-to-scan eSIM cards.
- Added a Best match section to country pages.
- Improved the upcoming trip overview.

  Translate 2.0
- Improved automatic website translation with on-device ML Kit.
- System language now follows all supported device languages.
- Added Dutch, English, Spanish, German, French, Italian and Portuguese as explicit translation targets.
- Translation now works with larger contextual text blocks for more natural results.
- Visible website content is translated first for faster perceived performance.
- Added support for dynamically loaded website content.
- Protected technical terms such as eSIM, SIM, APN, 5G, GB and prices from unnecessary translation.
- Added a temporary local translation cache.
- Added an option to download translation models over Wi-Fi only.

  Provider browser
- Improved the built-in provider browser.
- Official provider domains are now clearly identified.
- Leaving the verified provider domain is clearly indicated.
- Login, cart, checkout and payment flows continue to open in the system browser.
- Improved page title and translation status presentation.

  Performance
- No periodic background polling was added.
- Translation processing only runs while the in-app browser is active.
- Improved translation batching and debouncing to reduce unnecessary CPU usage.

apps.name: Customer Nearby
apps.description: Wereldwijde klantenservicezoeker met telefoon, WhatsApp, e-mail, websites en storingsinformatie.
apps.changelog: Customer Nearby 0.2.13 - Added direct curated Netherlands customer-service call actions for DELTA (0118 22 55 75), Ziggo (0900 1884) and Odido (0800 0092), while retaining existing KPN/Vodafone/Guidion profiles. - Added Odido's international service number and normalized current first-party support routes for Ziggo and Odido. - Booking.com NL now shows a descriptive Bericht of bel 24/7 action that opens Booking.com's official localized support flow instead of inventing a fixed phone number. - Contact-cache schema bumped to 7 so older sparse cached profiles cannot hide new curated contact actions. - Split outage routing into a user-facing preferred status URL and a separate regional automatic-detection URL. - KPN, Ziggo, Odido and DELTA now open verified first-party status/service checkers from the outage UI where available. - Added DELTA to the Netherlands outage catalogue. - Added a 30-minute per-country automatic backoff after regional outage-source 403/429 responses, preventing repeated Home/company-open retries against a temporarily blocked source. - Manual outage refresh may still explicitly retry; failed/unparseable checks remain UNKNOWN and never become false outage cards. - Added Dutch/English/Spanish strings for the new official-status and Booking.com contact UI. - Version bumped to 0.2.13 / versionCode 17.

apps.name: Data2U
apps.description: Smart mobile data tracking with app usage, SIM/eSIM insights, roaming, forecasts and widgets.
apps.changelog:
Data2U 0.5.6

Speed2U redesign

Completely redesigned Speed2U with a cleaner, modern speed test interface.
Added a live animated speed meter for download and upload tests.
Improved Material You styling with better contrast and readability.
Removed the prominent estimated data usage indicator from test results and history.
Wi-Fi speed testing
Speed2U can now test both mobile data and Wi-Fi connections.
Wi-Fi speed tests are kept separate from mobile data usage statistics.
Added clear Wi-Fi, mobile network and provider indicators.
Speed tests are pinned to the active network to prevent a Wi-Fi test from unexpectedly switching to mobile data.

Improved measurements
Improved latency measurement for more realistic idle ping results.
Ping measurement no longer includes the full HTTPS/TLS connection setup time.
Refined download, upload, ping and jitter reporting.

History
Cleaner Speed2U history cards.
Network type is now shown for previous tests.
Improved overall readability and layout.

Other
Performance and stability improvements.
Minor UI refinements and bug fixes.
